_comment: brain-sync: distill each repo's IMPORTANT changes (skills/conventions, architecture, API, deps/infra) into the shared Simbastack-hq/simbastack-brain repo as a PR — one per-repo file at 30-engineering/repos/<repo>.md, append-only, secret-scanned, never auto-merged. The brain location is GLOBAL config in config/sentinel.env (BRAIN_PATH + ENABLE_BRAIN_PR), NOT here — here you only enable it per repo. Use every:24h (a daily digest), never on-commit. Copy to config/targets.json and adjust paths; enable brain-sync on every repo you want fed into the brain.
